rationale: The evaluator feedback suggests further reducing the proportional gain kp and increasing the derivative gain kd to reduce steering oscillations and improve damping, based on iteration 1 evidence. Additionally, increasing the base speed to 1.7 is recommended if progress is low but stable, to push for higher progress while maintaining control. I have implemented these changes by setting kp to 2 (lower than before to reduce proportional response), kd to 10 (maximizing damping), and base_speed to 1.7 (increasing speed cautiously). The integral gain ki remains at 0.5 to maintain integral action, and sensor weights and line loss strategy remain unchanged as no issues were reported with them. The geometry is kept the same as previous iterations, which has proven stable and effective. I expect these changes to further reduce oscillations, improve stability, and increase progress and completion rates, especially on challenging tracks. I request measurements of completion, progress, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation to verify these effects in the next race.
